title: Log a match
kicker: Just finished? Log it, and once the admin approves it hits the board

game.title: Game
game.hint: Pick the game, then tap the format below.

seats.hint: Tap a ball to seat it, tap again to send it back. Someone new? Add a guest.

guest.taken: That name is already at the table
guest.hint: A new guest is only created once the admin approves.

winner.title: Winning side
winner.hintLoser: Tap whoever came last. They pay the bill.

score.title: Score
score.hint: Don't remember the score? Leave it empty.
score.orderWinner: The winning side needs the higher score.
score.orderLoser: The loser needs the lowest score.

note.label: Note (optional)
note.placeholder: e.g. lost the last bet, sank the black

send.hint: The match only reaches the leaderboard once the admin approves it.
send.hintEdit: Saving approves this match right away.

errors.busy: You or someone in this match already has a match without a result. Enter that result or cancel it first.
errors.too_large: That is too long, shorten the note and send again.
errors.invalid_body: This match is not valid yet, check the steps marked in red.
errors.conflict: This match has already been handled.
errors.not_found: This match was not found, it may have been cancelled.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired, please sign in again.
errors.failed: Could not send it, please try again.

schedule.title: Schedule now, result later
schedule.hint: Once the table is full, schedule it; after the game anyone in it can enter the result.
schedule.done: Scheduled, it is on the home page now.

signIn.title: Sign in to log a match
signIn.body: Only members can create matches, and only ones they play in.
signIn.unavailable: Google sign-in is not set up yet, ask the admin to log the match.

cancel.title: Cancel this match?
cancel.body: An unplayed match leaves the home page, and everyone in it can create a new one.

sent.title: Waiting for admin
sent.body: Sent. Once the admin approves it, the match goes on the board.

issues.memberName: That name belongs to a member, seat their ball instead of adding a guest.
issues.unknownPlayer: A player is no longer on the roster, pick again.
issues.duplicate: The same person appears twice in this match.
issues.scoreOrder: The scores do not match the winner.
issues.notSeated: You have to be one of the players in this match.
issues.invalid: This part is not valid yet, please check it.
